review.note: Reinstated in M44b. The M41b retraction said this actor would need a record of the decree of 22 March 1911, and universities-of-lisbon-and-porto-1911 is that record: the actor is named in it with the role institution. The retraction block is deleted because rule 27 makes a retraction on a non-retracted record an error, and its reason is copied verbatim into docs/m44-retractions.md under the heading Reinstated, in the same commit, so that the account of the withdrawal survives the undoing of it.
